facts: baseline analyze --kind cpu topProcesses ranked e.waterflowdemo first at runningNs 263783011 over a 10014872000 ns range, shareOfOneCPU 0.026339, sliceCount 229
baseline topThreads showed the process main thread (tid equal to pid) holding 256759007 ns, which is 97.3 percent of the process total, so the cost is on the UI thread

baseline slices at a 1 ms diagnostic threshold attributed 690.5 ms across 260 app slices, dominated by H:UITaskScheduler::FlushTask 95.03 ms over 40 slices, H:FlushLayoutTask 86.06 ms over 40 slices, H:CreateTaskMeasure[ListItem] 35.96 ms over 20 slices and H:CreateTaskMeasure[WaterFlow] 22.05 ms over 20 slices

contextCounterSampleWindow.reason: analyzer.schemaMismatch: trace-analysis@1 produced JSON outside ArkTrace analysis contract 1.0
contextCounterSampleWindow.rootCause: ArkTrace emits the last counter sample that precedes the requested window because a counter is a step function whose value holds until the next sample; ArkDeck validateCounterSample requires every sample timestamp to satisfy timestamp >= rangeStart and timestamp < rangeEnd
contextCounterSampleWindow.observed: 4 of 94 counter samples in a 100 ms window carried timestamps 6973805999 and 6973870999 against a window starting at 7010484760, each with a durationNs that reaches into the window
contextCounterSampleWindow.consequence: PHASE_6_SCENARIO.md section 6 item 4 is unmet; M1 to M5 do not depend on the context kind and were unaffected
contextCounterSampleWindow.owner: ArkDeck analyzer envelope validator, or ArkTrace if the contract is to be read as window-clipped

privacy.note: only the application under test is named; other process and thread names observed in the traces are treated as local sensitive artifacts and are not exported
